subject: Data residency evidence request — VPC bastion, KMS regions, and CAIQ pointers
messages:
From: Alice Ross <alice.ross@novahealth.com>
To: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Data residency + VPC connectivity evidence request

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for taking this. NovaHealth is completing our vendor security review for the upcoming pilot. We need a compact evidence packet covering the following, scoped to EU-hosted workloads: 

- Confirmation of the physical region(s) used for EU-hosted inference instances and where KMS keys are stored (region and any cross-region replicas).
- VPC connectivity pattern: peering / privatelink diagram showing traffic egress paths from EU nodes and any US fallbacks.
- Bastion/ops access model: whether there is a customer-dedicated bastion, jump hosts, or centralized management; include accepted authentication methods.
- Short CAIQ / SIG pointer: which CAIQ sections you consider as fully answered already and which require our input.
- SOC 2 snapshot (summary acceptable) and list of certificates/evidence pointers.

Is it possible to send a 1–2 page bundle (diagram + bulleted answers) by EOD Thursday (our time)? If you need a formal intake form we can provide one, but a short packet works best.

Best,
Alice
Alice Ross
Security Operations
NovaHealth

Attachments: none
From: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Ross <alice.ross@novahealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data residency + VPC connectivity evidence request

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the list. Looping in Irene (Security/compliance) and Marissa (Solutions/Onboarding). We can produce the packet; initial notes below and a proposed deliverable timeline: 

- EU regions: production inference for EU customers is served from eu-west-1 (primary) and eu-central-1 (standby for DR). KMS customer master keys for EU-tenants are provisioned in eu-west-1; we do not replicate keys to US unless the customer requests multi-region key replication.
- VPC pattern: we will produce a peering diagram (privatelink topology) that shows private endpoints, peering mesh to our dedicated EU gateway, and explicit outbound egress paths. We also annotate fallbacks to US-hosted inference pools that only occur when capacity constraints are met and only for non-sensitive workloads (customer-configurable).
- Bastion/ops access: we operate a customer-isolated bastion model in Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted accounts, operator access to nodes is controlled via ephemeral worker sessions, SSO (SAML/OIDC) + enforced MFA, and no persistent SSH keys on nodes. We have a hardened bastion runbook for private deployments; Irene will attach a hardening checklist.
- CAIQ/SIG: we maintain a CAIQ-lite mapping for common enterprise asks; we'll attach the sections that are already satisfied and flag items where evidence collection is needed (e.g., customer-specific key handling).
- SOC 2: attached is a 1-page summary and link to the cert hub for detailed artifacts (access-controlled).

Proposed timeline: diagram + checklist by 2026-10-07 EOD PT; full inventory CSV of KMS keys and short CAIQ mapping by 2026-10-08 if needed.

If that timing works, we'll send the first bundle by Friday morning EU time.

Thanks,
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Head of Field Security
Redwood Inference

--
Lukas Meyer
Redwood Inference | lukas.meyer@redwood.com
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Ross <alice.ross@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Data residency + VPC connectivity evidence request

Forwarding my draft evidence pack for Alice / NovaHealth. Attaching: vpc_peering_diagram_v2.pdf (diagram), bastion_hardening_checklist.txt (ops checklist), redwood_caIQ-lite-responses.pdf (CAIQ mapping), soc2-summary-redwood-2026.pdf (SOC 2 snapshot). Also included a KMS inventory CSV (redacted) — final will include key IDs scoped to the account, not global key material.

Key clarifications in the packet (bulleted):
- KMS: eu-west-1 is the canonical location for EU tenant CMKs. Cross-region replication to eu-central-1 is not automatic; it requires explicit opt-in and will be documented in the onboarding MOU.
- Access: For Private deployments we support customer-managed bastion (recommended) or Redwood-managed bastion with dedicated tenancy. Authentication methods supported: SAML SSO, FIDO2, and ephemeral short-lived certs via our identity broker.
- Egress & fallback: We have three explicit routing tiers: PRIMARY-EU (no cross-border egress), STANDBY-EU (same region but alternate AZs), and FALLBACK-US (activated only under policy and with consent). The packet includes the exact policy names and config flags.

Alice — if you want more granularity on any of these bullets (e.g., ports, ASGs, IP ranges), tell us which pieces to prioritize and we'll add them to the next pass.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vpc_peering_diagram_v2.pdf; bastion_hardening_checklist.txt; redwood_caIQ-lite-responses.pdf; soc2-summary-redwood-2026.pdf; kms_key_inventory_20261007.csv
From: Alice Ross <alice.ross@novahealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, lukas_meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data residency + VPC connectivity evidence request

Irene / Lukas —

This is exactly what we needed, thank you. The diagram and checklist answer most of our questions. Two quick follow ups before we close the intake: 

1) For the KMS inventory CSV you attached, can you confirm which key IDs are customer-scoped vs platform-scoped (a simple tag column would work)? We do not need key material — just metadata.
2) Under the fallback policy, is there a configurable flag at the customer level to opt out of cross-border fallback? If so, point me to the onboarding doc or the API flag name.

If you can send those two items (tag column + API flag name) tomorrow we can mark this as complete on our side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Security Operations, NovaHealth
